title: ResultDelivered
description: The answer to a provider's result: `POST /relay/v1/response/{transaction_id}` with a node token, whose body is the engine's own bytes — one JSON body (`application/json`), or its SSE lines as they come (`text/event-stream`). The master checks the framing and answers `400` ResultRejected for a malformed result, `409` for a stale attempt, `410` when the transaction already ended. An upload never wakes a sleeping grid.

x-headers.X-Grid-Provider-Attempt: The poll job's `provider_attempt_token`, when it carried one; a mismatch is answered 409.

ResultRejected.description: 400: the result's framing is wrong, and the request is failed rather than delivered.

ErrorReport.description: A provider's report that it could not serve the request: `POST /relay/v1/error/{transaction_id}`.

error.description: What failed, for the log; the public CLI sends a string.

tokens_delivered.description: Tokens already streamed; the relay retries on another provider only when none were.
